svg.title: Dyno features
svg.desc: Why is my PC slow?: The likeliest cause, with the evidence and what you can do about it. A health score with reasons: What holds it back, with fixes that preview first. Every change has an undo: Rules ease runaway programs, and every action can be undone. A weekly report in plain words: Highlights and busiest apps, exported as Markdown or a web page.
svg.text: A clear view of your PC, and a calm hand on it.
